note: Desired-state definitions for the Track B Devin Automations. Created in the Devin app (Settings > Automations) or via the Devin MCP; this file is the reviewable source of truth. Slack channel ids must be looked up, not guessed.

automations.name: gsk-ticket-to-pr
automations.output: PR on the repo; PR link, test totals and status commented back on the Jira issue

automations.name: gsk-backlog-fanout
automations.output: Three child sessions (SEC, BUG, COV), three PRs, summary on the Epic
automations.notes: Parent session needs permission to start child sessions unattended.

automations.name: gsk-zcode-reader
automations.output: docs/zcode/<object>.md PR; counts commented on the Jira issue

automations.name: gsk-rd-support-triage-jira
automations.output: Duplicate link, triage evidence or fix PR on the Jira issue

automations.name: gsk-rd-support-triage-slack
automations.output: Thread reply with duplicate / triage / PR

automations.name: gsk-gxp-evidence-pack
automations.output: Risk assessment, CSA or CSV route, document fan-out to child sessions on the PR branch; summary PR comment
automations.notes: Needs child-session approval bypass for the document fan-out.

automations.name: gsk-refine
automations.output: Refinement comment (AC, URS draft, impact, risk call); label refined-draft

automations.name: gsk-test-design
automations.output: Tests-only PR plus CSA record or OQ protocol with execution evidence

automations.name: gsk-qa-review-prep
automations.output: QA checklist and deviation drafts on the PR branch; ready / not ready comment

automations.name: gsk-release-pack
automations.output: Release notes, change-board pack, deploy and rollback plan PR; go / no-go comment

automations.name: gsk-security-remediation
automations.output: One fix PR per finding with scan delta, or a risk-acceptance draft

automations.name: gsk-security-scan-weekly
automations.action: start_code_scan (security, lite) with the profile from security/scan-profile.md
automations.notes: Not created: scans cost ACUs; create only if GSK wants a recurring scan. A one-off scan from the app is enough for the demo.

automations.name: gsk-s4-remediation-wave
automations.output: One remediation PR per ABAP object; wave summary on the Epic

automations.name: gsk-oncall-triage
automations.output: Comment on known issue, new Bug, runbook step or suppression recommendation
automations.notes: Devin Oncall responders are not set up in this org; this webhook automation stands in. The webhook URL and secret go in DEVIN_ONCALL_WEBHOOK_URL.

automations.name: gsk-audit-pack (API)
automations.output: Inspection pack and gap list returned from the session
automations.notes: Not an automation: started through the Devin API v3 to show integration from GSK tooling.
